items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: I want to work closely with them... I certainly would like to have Larry involved with me

ctx.x: picture with. And all in all I predict a bright future for jazz. I think I'm going to...what I want to try to do is work very closely with that boy...what's his name? From the school that play the bass?

Larry...people like that. I want to work closely with them and do what I can do to help. Because Boogie-Woogie can fit in anyplace, you know, and I could explain what it is, you know what I mean, and sometime this is good. This may be an interesting item for youngsters to see. Well, I certainly would like to have Larry involved with me and try to get it in the schools.
